---
title: "Contact"
---

Feel free to get in touch using the form below.

```{=html}
<form action="https://form.taxi/s/1b2pc6m4" method="POST">

  <!-- Honeypot field for spam protection -->
  <div style="position:absolute; left:-9999px;"
       aria-hidden="true">
    <label for="website">Leave this field empty</label>
    <input type="text"
           name="_gotcha"
           id="website"
           tabindex="-1"
           autocomplete="off">
  </div>

  <!-- Name -->
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="name" class="form-label">
      Name (optional)
    </label>
    <input type="text"
           name="name"
           id="name"
           class="form-control"
           autocomplete="name">
  </div>

  <!-- Email address -->
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="email" class="form-label">
      Email address *
    </label>
    <input type="email"
           name="email"
           id="email"
           class="form-control"
           autocomplete="email"
           required>
  </div>

  <!-- Message -->
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="message" class="form-label">
      Message *
    </label>
    <textarea name="message"
              id="message"
              class="form-control"
              rows="6"
              required></textarea>
  </div>

  <!-- Privacy information -->
  <p class="small text-muted">
    The information you provide will be processed
    to handle and respond to your inquiry.
    Please do not include sensitive personal information.
    For further details, see the
    <a href="privacy.html">Privacy Policy</a>.
  </p>

  <!-- Submit button -->
  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">
    Send message
  </button>

</form>
```
